column1: obliterate§One night's flooding obliterated a record that four generations of the family had kept by hand.§一夜的洪水**抹掉**了这家人四代手写保存的记录。§ob-（对着）+ liter（字母，同 literal 字面的）→ 把字擦掉
oblivion§The invention fell into oblivion for eighty years and was rediscovered by someone reading old patents.§这项发明被**遗忘**了八十年，被一个翻旧专利的人重新发现。§ob-（对着）+ liv ← lev（平滑，同 level 水平）→ 抹平了记忆
oblivious§He was oblivious to the tension in the room and talked cheerfully for another twenty minutes.§他对屋里的紧张气氛**浑然不觉**，又兴高采烈地讲了二十分钟。§
obnoxious§The tone of the message was obnoxious, and the four facts it contained were all correct.§这条消息的语气**令人厌恶**，而它包含的四个事实全都正确。§ob-（对着）+ nox（伤害，同 noxious 有毒的）
obscure§The clause is obscure enough that four law firms have given four different opinions on it.§这一条**晦涩**到四家律所给出了四种不同的意见。§ob-（遮盖）+ scur（覆盖，同 scarf 围巾）
obsequious§His obsequious manner with the director was matched by an equally striking rudeness to everyone else.§他对主任**谄媚逢迎的**做派，与对其他所有人同样惊人的粗鲁形成对照。§ob-（向）+ sequ（跟随，同 sequence 序列）→ 跟在后面伺候
observable§The effect is observable only in the four coldest weeks, which is why the first three studies missed it.§这个效应只在最冷的四周里**可观察到**，所以前三项研究都没发现。§
obsession§His obsession with the timetable produced the most accurate railway history anyone has written.§他对时刻表的**痴迷**产出了有人写过的最准确的铁路史。§ob-（对着）+ sess（坐，同 session 会期）→ 坐在心上不走
obsolete§The format became obsolete in 1998, and nine hundred hours of recordings are now unreadable.§这种格式在 1998 年**过时**，如今九百小时的录音无法读取。§ob-（对着）+ sol（习惯）→ 不再通行
obstinacy§Her obstinacy on the boundary question outlasted four councils and one change of government.§她在地界问题上的**固执**熬过了四届议会和一次政府更迭。§ob-（对着）+ stin ← st（站立，同 stand 站）→ 顶着不动
obstinate§The stain proved obstinate, and the conservator spent nine months removing what took a second to make.§这块污渍**顽固难除**，文物保护师花九个月清除了一秒钟造成的东西。§
obstreperous§The obstreperous minority held the floor for an hour, and the vote afterwards went nine to one against them.§这个**吵闹不休的**少数派占了一小时的发言权，随后的投票以九比一否决了他们。§ob-（对着）+ strep（喧闹）

obstruction§The obstruction turned out to be administrative rather than physical: a single signature, withheld for eleven straight months.§这道**障碍**原来是行政性的而非实体的——一个签名，硬是扣了十一个月。§ob-（对着）+ struct（建造，同 structure 结构）→ 挡在路上
obtrusive§The new sign is obtrusive from every window on the street, which is exactly what the objectors said it would be.§这块新招牌从街上每一扇窗看都**碍眼突兀**，正如反对者所预言。§ob-（对着）+ trud（推，同 intrude 闯入）→ 硬推到眼前
obtuse§He was being deliberately obtuse, and the fourth time she explained it he agreed at once.§他是在故意**装傻**，她第四次解释时他立刻就同意了。§ob-（对着）+ tus（打击，同 contusion 挫伤）→ 敲钝了
occasionally§The bridge floods occasionally, which the council defines as nine times in the last four years.§这座桥**偶尔**被淹，而议会对「偶尔」的定义是过去四年九次。§
occlusion§The occlusion was complete on one side, and the surgery restored blood flow within four hours.§一侧的**阻塞**是完全的，手术在四小时内恢复了血流。§ob-（对着）+ clus（关闭，同 include 包括）
odoriferous§The odoriferous heap behind the works was reported nine times before anyone came to look at it.§厂房后面那堆**散发异味的**东西被举报九次，才有人来看一眼。§odor（气味）+ fer（携带，同 transfer 转移）
officious§The officious clerk at the counter demanded a form that had been formally abolished four years earlier.§柜台后那位**多管闲事的**职员，索要一份四年前就已正式废止的表格。§offic（职务，同 office 办公室）→ 把职权用过了头
offset§Savings elsewhere offset the increase exactly, and the total budget did not move by a single pound.§别处的节省恰好**抵消**了这笔增加，总预算一英镑也没动。§off（离开）+ set（设置）
omission§The omission was small and fatal: the report never states which four years the figures cover.§这处**遗漏**微小而致命——报告从未说明这些数字涵盖哪四年。§ob-（离开）+ miss（送，同 mission 使命）→ 漏送了
onerous§The conditions are onerous enough that only nine of four hundred eligible households have applied.§这些条件**繁重**到四百户符合资格的家庭中只有九户申请。§oner（重担）
onset§The onset was gradual, and by the time anyone connected the symptoms four months had passed.§**发作**是渐进的，等到有人把症状联系起来，四个月已经过去。§on（在上）+ set（开始）
opacity§The opacity of the accounts is the finding: nine subsidiaries, and no consolidated statement anywhere.§账目的**不透明**本身就是结论——九家子公司，找不到任何一份合并报表。§op（遮蔽）
opinionated§The most opinionated person in the seminar changed her mind twice and said so both times.§研讨班上最**固执己见的**那位改了两次主意，两次都说了出来。§
opportune§The timing was opportune rather than lucky: she had watched the calendar for four months.§这个时机是**恰逢其时**而非走运——她盯了四个月的日历。§ob-（朝向）+ port（港口）→ 顺风入港的时机
opportunism§Opportunism is not a strategy, and the company discovered that in the four quarters after the boom.§**机会主义**不是战略，公司在繁荣后的四个季度里发现了这一点。§
opportunist§The opportunist changed sides twice in one afternoon and finished the day on the winning committee.§这位**投机者**一个下午改换阵营两次，收工时坐在了获胜的委员会里。§
opportunistic§The infection is opportunistic: it harms nobody with a working immune system and kills without one.§这种感染是**机会性的**——它伤不到免疫系统正常的人，没有免疫力则致命。§
opposition§Opposition to the plan came from four directions at once, and none of the four spoke to each other.§对这项计划的**反对**同时来自四个方向，而这四方彼此从未交谈。§ob-（对着）+ posit（放置，同 position 位置）
opt§Nine of the eleven schools opted out, and the scheme was abandoned before the second year began.§十一所学校中有九所**选择**退出，方案在第二年开始前就被放弃。§opt（选择，同 option 选项）
optimism§Optimism about the schedule survived four missed milestones in a row and finally died at the fifth.§对进度的**乐观**连着熬过四个错过的节点，最终死在第五个上。§optim（最好，同 optimum 最佳）
opulent§The opulent interior was paid for by a business that collapsed nine months after the house was finished.§这处**富丽堂皇的**室内装修，出资的生意在房子完工九个月后就垮了。§op（财富）
orb§The orb of the sun sat on the horizon for what felt like an hour at that latitude in June.§六月在那个纬度，太阳的**圆轮**似乎在地平线上停了一个小时。§orb（圆，同 orbit 轨道）
originality§The originality is in the method, not the result: four groups reached the same number by harder routes.§**原创性**在于方法而非结果——四个小组用更难的路径得出了同样的数字。§origin（起源）
ornamentation§The ornamentation was added to the façade in 1890 and removed again, at considerable expense, in 1974.§这些**装饰**是 1890 年加到立面上的，1974 年又花大价钱拆掉。§ornament（装饰品）
ornate§The ornate frame is worth more than the painting inside it, which nobody mentions on the label.§这个**华丽的**画框比框里的画还值钱，而标签上没人提这一点。§orn（装饰，同 ornament 装饰品）
ossify§The procedure ossified into ritual, and nobody in the department could say what problem it originally solved.§这套流程**僵化**成了仪式，系里没人说得出它最初解决的是什么问题。§oss（骨）+ fy（使）
ostensible§The ostensible reason was cost, and the file shows the decision had been made four months earlier.§**表面上的**理由是成本，而卷宗显示决定四个月前就已做出。§ob-（向）+ tens（伸展，同 tension 张力）→ 摆出来给人看
ostentatious§The gift was ostentatious and unwelcome, and the museum returned it with a very polite letter.§这份礼物**炫耀张扬**且不受欢迎，博物馆用一封极客气的信退了回去。§
oust§Four members ousted the chair at a meeting the chair himself had called for another purpose.§四名成员在主席自己为别的事召集的会上把他**赶下了台**。§
outdated§The equipment was outdated in 1994 and is still running, which nobody in the industry can quite explain.§这套设备在 1994 年就已**过时**，如今仍在运转，业内没人能完全解释。§
outmode§Cheap digital sensors outmoded a whole class of laboratory instrument within about four years of reaching the market.§廉价数字传感器上市后约四年，就让一整类实验室仪器**沦为过时之物**。§out（超出）+ mode（时尚）
outrage§The outrage lasted nine days, and the rule that caused it was quietly reinstated the following spring.§这场**义愤**持续九天，而引发它的规定在次年春天被悄悄恢复。§
overabundance§An overabundance of applicants is not a good problem: the committee read four hundred files in nine days.§申请人**过多**不是好事——委员会九天读了四百份材料。§over（过多）+ abundance（丰富）
overhaul§The engine was overhauled in March and failed in April, and the report blames a part nobody replaced.§这台发动机三月**大修**，四月就坏了，报告归咎于一个没人更换的部件。§over（全面）+ haul（拖）
overjoy§The result overjoyed a town that had expected, quite reasonably, to lose the hospital altogether.§这个结果让一座本来相当合理地预期会彻底失去医院的小镇**喜出望外**。§
overpower§The smell of the solvent overpowered everyone within four metres, and the room was evacuated at once.§溶剂的气味**压倒**了四米之内的所有人，房间当即被疏散。§
overshadow§The scandal overshadowed nine years of decent work, and the obituaries mention it in the first line.§这桩丑闻**盖过**了九年正经的工作，讣告第一行就提到它。§over（在上）+ shadow（影子）
oversight§The oversight was in the transcription, not the analysis, and it changed the conclusion entirely.§这处**疏漏**出在誊录而非分析上，却完全改变了结论。§over（越过）+ sight（看）→ 看漏了
overweening§His overweening confidence in the forecast survived four separate revisions, every one of them sharply downward.§他对这份预测**过于自负的**信心熬过了四次修订，而每一次都是大幅下调。§over（过度）+ ween（认为）
pacifist§The pacifist spent four years in prison and, afterwards, forty years running the town's ambulance service.§这位**和平主义者**坐了四年牢，此后四十年经营着镇上的救护车服务。§pac（和平，同 peace 和平）+ fic（做）
painstaking§Her painstaking reconstruction of the ledger took nine months and settled a dispute of forty years.§她对这本账簿**一丝不苟的**复原花了九个月，了结了一场四十年的争议。§pains（辛苦）+ taking（花费）
palliative§The measure is palliative rather than curative, and everyone involved has said so in writing.§这项措施是**治标不治本的**，所有相关方都书面这么说过。§palli（斗篷）→ 拿披风盖住
palpable§The relief in the room was palpable, and four people who had said nothing all morning began talking at once.§屋里的宽慰**几乎可以触摸**，四个整个上午没说话的人同时开了口。§palp（触摸，同 palpate 触诊）
panache§She handled the collapse with a panache that made the audience think it was part of the act.§她以一种**潇洒气派**处理了那次倒塌，让观众以为这是表演的一部分。§
panoply§The full panoply of ceremony was deployed for a visit that lasted, in the end, nineteen minutes.§全套**盛大排场**为一次访问而铺开，而这次访问最终只有十九分钟。§pan（全部）+ hopla（甲胄）
panoramic§The panoramic photograph from 1908 shows four buildings that no longer exist and one that never did.§1908 年那张**全景**照片上有四栋已不存在的建筑，还有一栋从未存在过。§pan（全部）+ horama（景象）
pantomime§The whole exchange was pantomime: both sides had agreed the outcome the previous afternoon.§整场交锋不过是**哑剧**——双方前一天下午就已谈妥结果。§pan（全部）+ mim（模仿，同 mimic 模仿）
paradigm§The paradigm held for forty years and collapsed when four anomalies turned out to share one cause.§这个**范式**维持了四十年，在四个异常现象被发现同源时崩塌。§para（旁边）+ deigma（示例）
paradox§The paradox is only apparent: the two statements use the same word in two different senses.§这个**悖论**只是表面上的——两句话在两种不同意义上使用同一个词。§para（相反）+ dox（观点，同 orthodox 正统的）
paragon§She is held up as a paragon of the method and privately says she broke its main rule four times.§她被树为这套方法的**典范**，私下却说自己四次违反了它的主要规则。§
paramount§Safety is paramount in the handbook and, on the evidence of nine incidents, secondary in practice.§手册里安全**至高无上**，而从九起事故看，实践中它是次要的。§para（在上）+ mount（山）
parch§Four dry months parched a valley whose river had not failed in living memory.§四个干旱的月份**烤干**了一条河谷，而人们记忆中它的河从未断流。§
parochial§The debate is parochial in the strict sense: it matters enormously here and nowhere else at all.§这场辩论严格说来是**地方性的**——它在这里极其重要，在别处毫无意义。§paroch（教区，同 parish 教区）
parody§The parody was funnier than its target and, within four years, better known than the original.§这篇**戏仿**比它的对象更好笑，四年内也比原作更出名。§para（旁边）+ ode（歌，同 melody 旋律）
partial§The account is partial in both senses: incomplete, and written by someone with a stake in the outcome.§这份记述在两种意义上都是**片面的**——既不完整，又出自一个与结果有利害关系的人之手。§part（部分）
